use the recipient phrase only if appropriate and authorised
drop subject pronouns where natural

load the full AI-tell taxonomy

own the inference in Krish's uncertainty register

must: stop the number from entering final copy
preserve the conflict

load the domain owner and current transaction surface
replace only from verified current evidence

retain dry confidence

minimise private context
